landing.heroEyebrow: Government of Maharashtra · Public Health Infrastructure
landing.heroTitle: Building Healthier Communities, One Hospital at a Time
landing.heroSubtitle: A unified command center for tracking every public hospital construction project — from administrative sanction to operational handover — with real-time transparency, verified quality and accountable spend.
landing.quote: The health of the people is really the foundation upon which all their happiness and all their powers as a state depend.
landing.leadershipSubtitle: Every hospital project is answerable up this chain of accountable roles.
landing.leadershipNote: Illustrative role-holders from this demonstration prototype — not real office-bearers.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything oversight needs, in one place
landing.featuresSubtitle: Purpose-built for the way government infrastructure programmes actually run.
landing.feature1Desc: Live physical and financial progress across every hospital, from foundation to handover.
landing.feature2Desc: Every rupee sanctioned, released and spent is traceable through a verified approval chain.
landing.feature3Desc: Geo-tagged photos, inspections and defect closure evidence at every construction milestone.
landing.feature4Desc: Nine-plus accountable role tiers, from field engineers to the Superadmin who governs access itself.
landing.footerTagline: Secure government access · Role-based authorization · Full audit trail
